title: The Realigned Day an Auto Loan Installment Falls Due On
content:
The realigned day an installment on a loan of the Auto Loans line falls due on is the day the loan's current due day reaches once the realignment shift is added to it, any part day being dropped.

The realignment shift is the base shift, the record credit and the deposit credit added together, and it is never more than the number of days the product publishes as its largest move of the due day.

The base shift is 3 days.

The scheduled installments counted for the record credit are all those credited over the life of the loan, and the record credit is one day for each whole 6 of them, with any part day dropped.

The deposit measure is the most recent recurring deposit posted to the borrower's checking account, and the deposit credit is one day for each whole 2000.00 of that measure, any part day being dropped, multiplied by a deposit step of 1.0.

## Which figure the ceiling acts on

The three credits are settled first and added together to give the shift. The published ceiling on the move is applied to that sum, not to any credit on its own. The day is then reached by adding the shift, as the ceiling leaves it, to the day the loan currently falls due.

## A realignment worked out on hypothetical readings

| Reading | Value |
|---|---|
| Day of the month the loan currently falls due | 6 |
| Scheduled installments credited over the life of the loan | 20 |
| Most recent recurring deposit posted to the borrower's checking account | 5200.00 USD |
| Largest move of the due day the product publishes | 15 days |

The record credit is one day for each whole 6 of the 20 installments, which is three whole sixes and a part dropped, giving 3 days.

The deposit credit is one day for each whole 2000.00 of 5200.00, which is two whole amounts and a part dropped, giving 2 days, multiplied by a deposit step of 1.0, which leaves 2 days.

The shift is 3 together with 3 together with 2, which is 8 days. That is below the published ceiling of 15, so the ceiling leaves it at 8.

The realigned day is 6 together with 8, which is day 14 of the month.

## When the ceiling holds the shift down

Were the same loan to show 60 installments credited over its life and a most recent recurring deposit of 12500.00 USD, the record credit would be 10 days and the deposit credit 6 days, giving a sum of 19 days. The published ceiling of 15 days would hold the shift to 15, and the realigned day would be day 21 of the month.
